content.text: The focused setup tests passed. I’m doing one quick diff review now to make sure the call sites only trigger after actual agent installation and that the user-facing text is coherent.

Added Vercel detection to the setup flows in [setup.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-cli/cmd/entire/cli/setup.go). After actual agent installation in `entire enable`, `entire configure`, or `entire configure --agent`, the CLI now checks for `.vercel`, `vercel.json`, or `vercel.ts`. If Vercel is present and `vercel.json` does not already disable `entire/*` deployments, it prompts the user and, on approval, writes or merges:

```json
"git": {
  "deploymentEnabled": {
    "entire/*": false
  }
}
```

The merge preserves existing `vercel.json` fields and existing `git.deploymentEnabled` entries. In non-interactive runs, it prints a note instead of prompting.

I also added targeted tests in [setup_test.go](/Users/thomi/Projects/entire-cli/cmd/entire/cli/setup_test.go) covering merge behavior, creating a new `vercel.json` when only Vercel markers exist, and skipping the prompt when the setting is already present.

Verified with:
`go test ./cmd/entire/cli -run 'TestMaybePromptVercelDeploymentDisable'`
`go test ./cmd/entire/cli -run 'TestManageAgents_AddAndRemove|TestRunEnable|TestConfigureCmd'`

I did not run the full repo test suite.
